exposure: Number of children younger than 5 years in the household
cohort: 1,640 children under the age of five years from two municipalities in Piauí, Brazil.
finding: While stunting rates were inversely associated with several socioeconomic factors and decreased with age, excess weight prevalence was high and remained inversely associated with lower maternal age, low maternal education, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Excess weight prevalence was inversely associated with cesarean delivery.
